Class employee_main_window

java.lang.Object
controller.employee_main_window
All Implemented Interfaces:
javafx.fxml.Initializable
public class employee_main_window extends Object implements javafx.fxml.Initializable
This class handles the logic for employee/managers to use the Point of Sales system.

Users will be able to:

  • Choose a drink from a list.
  • Can sort the drink items based on certain categories.
  • Customize the drink.
  • Add it to the current order.
  • Edit a drink already in the order.
  • Allow customers to choose or input a tip amount.
  • Finalize order and save it to order history.
  • Change to manager mode session.
  • LogOut to initial loading screen.

    • renderDrinkGrid

      private void renderDrinkGrid(List<employee_main_window.Drink> drinkList)
      Creates/formats the drink item buttons into the GridPlane.

      Each drink will be its own button. The GridPlane formats it with a strict number of 3 columns. Seasonal drinks will be purple while drink items (which is a regular drink) will be blue.

      Parameters:

    • handleSortAvailable

      private void handleSortAvailable(javafx.event.ActionEvent event)
      Sorts the drink item buttons based on whether the drink item is in stock in the inventory or not.

      If stock quantity is greater than zero then the drink item will be at the top of the GridPlane and at the bottom otherwise. getOutOfStockItems() is used to get a list of all the drink names that are out of stock (when quantity is less than 1) It utilizes the renderDrinkGrid(List) method to show create/show the updated drink item GridPlane.

      Parameters:
      event - The ActionEvent to call this method is when the user selects this sort option in the 'Filter' MenuButton.
      See Also:
      • renderDrinkGrid(List)
      • getOutOfStockItems()

    • getOutOfStockItems

      private List<String> getOutOfStockItems()
      Creates a list of the drink names of items that are out of stock.

      Out of stock means that the quantity is less than 1. It only looks at the base item type quantities of the drink not at any toppings. The outputted list will be used in the method handleSortAvailable(ActionEvent)

      Returns:
      This list contains all the names of the drinks that are out of stock in the inventory.

    • handleSortPopular

      private void handleSortPopular(javafx.event.ActionEvent event)
      Sorts the drink item buttons based on the frequency of how much the drink is ordered.

      The drink with the highest order frequency is in the top left of the GridPlane while the drink with the least order frequencyis in the bottom right. getPopularDrinksFromPastTwoMonths() is used to get a list of alll the drinks in order of decreasing frequency. It utilizes the renderDrinkGrid(List) method to show create/show the updated drink item GridPlane.

      Parameters:
      event - The ActionEvent to call this method is when the user selects this sort option in the 'Filter' MenuButton.
      See Also:
      • renderDrinkGrid(List)
      • getPopularDrinksFromPastTwoMonths()

    • addDrinkToOrder

      public void addDrinkToOrder(String name, String topping, int qty, String size)
      Gets the current customized drink order and adds it to the current order display

      Every individual drink order will have:

      • Drink name button
      • Chosen topping
      • Chosen size
      • Individual drink subtotal

      Utilizes the method getItemCostFromDatabase(String) to get the cost of the drink and the topping. A medium size drink is the same as the base cost of the drink item. Adds a cost fee to the drink item cost for chosing a large sized drink. Utilized the method refreshCartDisplayPanel() to update the current order display

      Parameters:
      name - The name of the selected drink
      topping - The name of the selected topping
      qty - The number of this specific drink to add to the current order
      size - The size of this drink (either medium or large)
      See Also:
      • refreshCartDisplayPanel()

    • refreshCartDisplayPanel

      public void refreshCartDisplayPanel()
      Creates/refreshes the display for the current order

      The display will have all currently added drinks. Every individual drink order will have:

      • Drink name button
      • Chosen topping
      • Chosen size
      • Individual drink subtotal

      Will format the drink name as a button for the method on_edit_drink_button_click(store_order_values) Uses the method calculateAndRenderTotals() to handle the final calculations of the cost total

    • handleTipButtonClick

      private void handleTipButtonClick(javafx.event.ActionEvent event)
      Creates popup for the tip window when the tip button is pushed.

      Accesses the FXML file path '/views/choose_tips.fxml' and switches the screen over to it. Also allows its corresponding java file to take control over that popup window ('choose_tips_window.java')

      Allows users to either choose:

      • A percentage amount for the tip which will calculate it based of the order subtotal.
      • To enter a specified decimal amount of dollars for the tip.
      Parameters:
      event - The ActionEvent to call this method is when the user selects this sort option in the 'Filter' MenuButton.

    • handleFinishOrderButtonClick

      private void handleFinishOrderButtonClick(javafx.event.ActionEvent event)
      Creates popup for the finish order window when the finish order button is pushed.

      Accesses the FXML file path '/views/finish_order.fxml' and switches the screen over to it. Also allows its corresponding java file to take control over that popup window ('finish_order_window.java')

      This popup will allow users to collect final information (phone number and payment type) from customers to finalize the order. If there is nothing in the current order then the popup window won't open and this method will do nothing.

      Parameters:
      event - The ActionEvent to call this method is when the user selects this sort option in the 'Filter' MenuButton.

    • clearActiveOrder

      public void clearActiveOrder()
      Erases all the drinks in the current order display and resets variablesthat handle order costs

      Is used to reset when the order is successfully placed or the user presses the clear current order button. Also uses the method calculateAndRenderTotals() to handle the reset of calculations of the total order value back to 00.00

    • on_edit_drink_button_click

      private void on_edit_drink_button_click(store_order_values itemToEdit)
      Creates popup for the edit drink window when a drink name button in the current order display is pressed.

      Accesses the FXML file path '/views/edit_order.fxml' and switches the screen over to it. Also allows its corresponding java file to take control over that popup window ('edit_order_window.java')

      This popup will allow users to edit the information of the specified drink except for the name of the chosen drink. This includes:

      • The chosen topping
      • The size
      • The quantity
      Will update the new subtotal of the specified drink. It will also handle the logic of explicitly seperating the drink orders if the initial quantity was more than 1.
      Parameters:
      itemToEdit - The list of all the data pertaining to one specified drink. Thos includes the drink name, topping name, quantity of the drink, drink size, and the subtotal
